text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing facilitator shifts for the annual planning offsite (Tue-Fri). Need volunteers for hybrid room tech lead + a 30m run-through slot. Who can cover Thurs morning (9-11)?
kevin: I can take the hybrid tech lead Thurs 8:30–12:30. Happy to do a 30m run-through too.
sam: I can do the run-through at 9:15 on Thurs. Will bring a mic checklist.
oliver: Are there documented AV/internet requirements? want to flag bandwidth for a 50% remote cohort.
jen: +1 on checklist. Also we should confirm recording consent and whether we post recordings to Confluence.
maria: Good call — legal flagged opt-in for recordings last year. Planner: recordings only if all participants consent. I'll add to the agenda.
maria: AV/network notes (short):
```
- 2x boundary mics
- dedicated 100Mbps uplink per room (recommended)
- HDMI switch + backup dongles (USB-C, MiniDP)
- local laptop with offline slides as fallback
```
kevin: I'll bring an HDMI splitter and an extra WiFi AP. Can someone bring a spare USB-C dongle?
jen: I have spare dongles. Also prepping a consent slide for the start of each session.
sam: Can we run a full tech run-through Mon 30m slot? would like to test breakout reconnection flow + polling.
maria: Yes — Mon 4pm for full run-through. sam and kevin confirmed. jen can run consent slide. oliver, can infra route a temporary VLAN for the rooms?
oliver: I can request VLAN; will need room IDs and expected devices. pinged infra ticket: #INFRA-4578.
planner-bot: Reminder: RSVP for offsite closes in 72 hours. Link: https://company.internal/offsite/rsvp
kevin: Also recommended facilitation rotation: morning facilitator pairs for contextual continuity. I'll draft a rotation doc.
maria: Perfect. Action items: 1) kevin bring extra AP/HDMI; 2) jen prepares consent slide; 3) sam + kevin run Mon 4pm tech check; 4) oliver files VLAN ticket (done). I'll update the facilitator rota and share final agenda by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
